resources.string: 1. Click the power button one to turn on the Light Stick\n2. Press and hold the power button for 5 seconds. When the light stick blinks, click on the \"Find\" button in app.
Click on device name in list to connect to Light Stick
Please set up necessary app permissions
Please set up Location Permission first
Please set up Bluetooth Permission first

Pleas set up Record Audio Permission for enabling Audio Visualizer. The Visualizer enables application to retrieve part of the currently playing audio for visualization purpose. It is not an audio recording interface and only returns partial and low quality audio content.
Play audio on device and start visualizer!
You should provide Scan Permission to find Exo Fanlight sticker for connection.
You should provide Connect Permission to connect to Exo Fanlight sticker.
